RM............................................... (Ringgit: ………...............................) if you

admit committing the offence and make a request in the form attached for the

offence to be compounded.

3. If you accept this offer, payment shall be made in cash or by money order,

postal order, cashier's order, banker's cheque or bank draft made payable to

the Director General, Fire and Rescue Department and crossed with the words

"Account Payee Only".

4. This offer expires on ..........................

5. If full payment of the sum stated in paragraph 2 is received on or before

the date stated in paragraph 4, no further proceedings will be taken against

you in respect of this offence. Otherwise, prosecution will be instituted without

further notice.

Offences Under The Act

Section Description

23(4) Not giving written notice to the State Director before carrying

out works affecting fire hydrant

(subsection 23(1)).

Not rendering fire hydrant in good working condition after

carrying out works affecting the fire hydrant

(subsection 23(2)).

25(2) Refusing to allow the fixing of plate indicating location of

fire hydrant.

Obstructing the person fixing the plate.

Removing or defacing the plate after it has been affixed.

26 Covering, enclosing or concealing fire hydrant.

Tampering with fire hydrant.

Using fire hydrant other than for fire fighting purpose.

47 Entering or remaining, without the permission of a Fire

Officer, in premises possession of which has been taken by

the Director General.

52 Failing to comply with the directions given by an authorized

officer.

55 Damaging, concealing, activating or deactivating fire alarm

without reasonable excuse.
